final: WITH order_rates AS (SELECT orderslink, AVG(feerate - rebrate) AS avg_net_fee_rate, AVG(rebtotal) AS avg_rebate FROM fees GROUP BY orderslink), overall_rate AS (SELECT AVG(feerate - rebrate) AS avg_net_fee_rate FROM fees) SELECT AVG(order_rates.avg_rebate) AS mean_average_total_rebate, AVG(order_rates.avg_net_fee_rate) AS mean_average_net_fee_rate, AVG(order_rates.avg_net_fee_rate - overall_rate.avg_net_fee_rate) AS mean_excess_net_fee_rate FROM order_rates CROSS JOIN overall_rate WHERE order_rates.avg_net_fee_rate > overall_rate.avg_net_fee_rate
